observations.why: The declarative 'we are adopting' enacts a decisional stance — announcing a settled choice for the collective, performing authority over the group's direction rather than proposing or negotiating.
The proportional performance comparison frames the decision in cost-benefit terms — quantified advantage over the current setup, the classic proportionality register.
The commissive commits the collective to a shared timeline — 'the migration' as a we-undertaking binds speaker and audience into one body moving together.
The note-taker ratifies and re-presents the decisions as settled items under a 'Key decisions' heading, performing the authority-ranking move of recording what has been decided for the group.
